notes: The two the's of the statute of the law are placed by rule 29's arthrous case: the article on torah takes the one standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one, nothing being fronted.
without spot is headed on spot under rule 24, no word realizing the lexeme of temimah directly; the competing head on without was rejected because a bare without says nothing.
The and before the second relative clause is added: no conjunction morpheme stands in that clause (rule 14), and the ASV markup corroborates without deciding it (rule 7).
'eleyka is unrepresented and its suffix takes thee, the ASV writing a bare indirect object bring thee (rule 40).
asher-bah fuses as wherein under rule 22's closing sentence, while the later asher ... 'aleyha is written as two words and so splits, the suffix going unrepresented.
